page_title: BOL 1-2 FIO | Bologna v Fiorentina 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Juan Miranda (Bologna) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+4' A substitution has been made. Nicolo Fagioli goes off and Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) comes on.
90+2' A decent cross gives Santiago Castro (Bologna) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.

88' 1 - 2 A perfect lofted pass from Jonathan Rowe finds Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and David de Gea had no chance of stopping that. 1:2.
85' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
84' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

83' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
80' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabiano Parisi leaves the pitch and Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) comes on.
79' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Juan Miranda (Bologna) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Bologna players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
72' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) replaces Tommaso Pobega.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Cher Ndour walks off the pitch to be replaced by Simon Sohm (Fiorentina).
72' A substitution has been made. Albert Gudmundsson is replaced by Manor Solomon (Fiorentina).
72' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is substituted due to injury. Paolo Vanoli gives a chance to Marco Brescianini.
70' Nikola Moro (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
69' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but David de Gea comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
65' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
63' Half-chance! Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) plays a pass into the box, but David de Gea reacts well to snuff out the attack.
62' Bologna keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
57' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Dodo (Fiorentina) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
55' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Santiago Castro (Bologna) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
55' The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.

55' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.

53' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Federico Ravaglia was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
52' Bologna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
50' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) jumps into a tackle and Daniele Doveri signals a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Vincenzo Italiano decided to make a change. Remo Freuler (Bologna) is replaced by Nikola Moro.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincenzo Italiano probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Emil Holm (Bologna). He is replaced by Nadir Zortea.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) comes off for Jonathan Rowe.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian.
46' 2 - 1 The second half gets underway.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' 0 - 2 Goal! The rebound fell to Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) and he fired home from close range. The score is 0:2.
45+1' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Daniele Doveri wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) has a goal ruled out for offside!
45' Emil Holm (Bologna) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
42' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
41' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
41' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Emil Holm (Bologna) for his blatant foul.

38' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
35' Fine attempt! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
31' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Emil Holm (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bologna.
28' Emil Holm (Bologna) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
28' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
25' Remo Freuler (Bologna) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
23' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
22' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
22' Flag up against Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

19' 0 - 1 Goal! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Albert Gudmundsson assisted in the goal. 0:1.
18' The goal by Fiorentina won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
18' Wait! Referee Daniele Doveri has indicated he is going to review the Fiorentina goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
17' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) latches on to a sweet pass and scores with aplomb. His low drive goes in off the left post. Fabulous goal!
14' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' Bologna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
9' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
7' What a miss! The corner finds Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
7' The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Dodo (Fiorentina) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. It will be a corner kick for Fiorentina.
6' What a great touch by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the centre of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
4' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
4' Bologna are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
